media.title: Pierre Billon on the set of Courrier Sud — portrait detail, 1937
media.altText: Sepia-toned halftone portrait detail of film director Pierre Billon during production of Courrier Sud in 1937.
media.publicCaption: Pierre Billon during production of Courrier Sud, 1937. Portrait detail from a press-clipping page whose contemporary caption identifies him as the film’s director.
media.publicCreditLine: Portrait detail from Bibliothèque nationale de France / Gallica, Recueil. “Courrier Sud” film de Pierre Billon, 1937, page 5 of 28; via Wikimedia Commons.
media.rightsNote: Public domain according to the Wikimedia Commons file record (PD France) for the 1937 press-clipping page from the Bibliothèque nationale de France / Gallica collection. The photographer and original periodical of the embedded photograph are not identified in the item metadata. The local image is an unretouched crop of Pierre Billon from that page; the linked source record preserves the complete page and its contemporary identifying caption.
